diagnosis: ScheduledTaskUpdateView allows modifying the execution schedule and state of background tasks managed by django-celery-beat. The view retrieves PeriodicTask directly by task_id without verifying that the task's name or metadata belongs to request.user.organization. An attacker can disable critical recurring synchronization jobs or alter the crontab frequency of other organizations' tasks.
